title: Sum of pairwise diagonal weights
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\delta\in\mathbb R$, and let $U$ be a finite subset of the $n$ coordinates. The sum over ordered pairs $(i,j)\in U\times U$, assigning weight $\delta$ when $i=j$ and $\delta^2$ otherwise, equals $\delta^2|U|^2+\delta(1-\delta)|U|$.
hypotheses_covered: $U$ is a finite subset of the $n$ coordinates
